help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:448  The first line answers the question the timer cannot: it reads the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:449  `run-state.json` written by the last `run-once` pass. Three distinct
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:450  answers, and only the first is a healthy one:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:451
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:452  * last run recent and successful -> exit 0
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:453  * last run FAILED -> exit 1, saying which step failed

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:456    usually leaves a *successful* last run behind, so this overdue check
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:457    is the only thing that catches it.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:636  Initialise a new destination as a *full extra copy* (ADR-013).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:637
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:638  Order is fixed: re-collect from the local sources first (they are the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:639  truth, and rereading them puts no load on an existing destination),
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:640  then copy back only what an existing destination holds and the local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:641  source no longer does, then push the result. The new destination ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:642  up with `local ∪ existing destinations`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:643
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:644  A source destination that cannot be consulted makes the difference set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:645  *incomplete*: that is reported and the command exits non-zero. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:646  never treated as "that destination had nothing extra".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:648  Destination to initialise. Must be declared in the config, unless
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:649  an explicit `--repo` is given instead.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:652  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:677  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:680  Record this destination's ssh host key in `~/.ssh/known_hosts` after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:681  printing its fingerprint. Off by default and never implied: without
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:682  this flag nothing is ever written to `known_hosts`, so the first
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:683  connection of an unattended run cannot silently trust a host.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:687  Search one destination's archive by session metadata.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:688
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:689  Metadata tier only: this walks snapshot/index/tree objects plus each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:690  machine's small activity index, and never fetches or decrypts a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:691  session's conversation shard, which is why it is cheap. On a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:692  three-session fixture the metadata walk read 11,761 bytes against
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:693  1,206,285 bytes of data packs — two orders of magnitude apart.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:694  In a separate metadata-only run, use `--cost` to estimate the payload
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:695  size before choosing a full-text mode. `--scan` reads those payloads;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:696  `--text` uses the local index and checks that it covers the selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:697  sessions before treating zero hits as a complete answer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:698
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:699  One destination per run, always named: there is no automatic merge
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:700  across destinations, and no default destination to search "everything".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:701
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:702  The time window filters on the **conversation's own activity interval**,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:703  not on when the backup ran: a session matches when `[first message,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:704  last message]` intersects the window. Those times come from the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:705  `activity-index` sidecar (`meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`) carried in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:706  the archive, so `--day 2026-01-15` finds a conversation held that day
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:707  even if the machine was last pushed months later.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:708
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:709  A session whose conversation time is unknown is **never silently
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:710  excluded**. It is listed separately with the reason, and while a time
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:711  window is active it does not count as a match — which also means a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:712  "0 matched" answer cannot be trusted while any remain, so the exit code
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:713  is `3` rather than `1`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:714
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:715  `--text` searches the local FTS5 trigram index (substring matching for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:716  runs of at least three characters). A shorter query is refused, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:717  answered: the report says `matched=unknown` and the run exits `3`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:718  `--scan` reads selected conversations and matches them as plain text
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:719  instead; it answers short queries, at the cost of reading them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:720
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:721  Exit codes distinguish the three answers, because two of them look the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:722  same and mean opposite things: `0` matched something, `1` read the whole
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:723  destination and answered for every session with no match, `3` could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:724  finish — reading it, placing every session in time, or evaluating the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:725  query — so a zero proves nothing. `2` is a usage error, as elsewhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:727  Destination to search. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:730  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:733  Search indexed titles and user/assistant text with SQLite's trigram tokenizer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:736  Read selected sessions and perform a case-insensitive substring scan.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:739  Emit one JSON object on stdout. Metadata searches include separate
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:740  matched / not matched / could-not-be-placed groups; text searches
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:741  carry coverage, read failures and a `query_state` for the query.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:744  Also report what a full-text pass over the hits would cost.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:747  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:750  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:753  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:756  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:759  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:763  Write every session the shared selector selects to files.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:764
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:765  One destination per run, always named, exactly like `search` — and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:766  selection is literally the same code path: `export` writes the sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:767  `search` returns for the same flags, so `search` is the dry run of this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:768  command with a different name, and `--dry-run` prints the same price
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:769  `search --cost` reports before anything is fetched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:770
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:771  Layout: `<out>/<machine>/<harness>/<session-id>.jsonl`, each file holding
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:772  that session's archived lines in their native format, byte-identical to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:773  what `read` returns for it. Plus `<out>/manifest.json`: per session its
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:774  machine, harness, id, first and last message time, shard count, bytes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:775  written, sha256 of the written file and the filters that were applied —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:776  and, at the top level, the sessions no filter could place, the machines
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:777  whose activity index could not be read, the sessions that could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:778  written, and the exit status this run returns.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:779
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:780  `--turns user` keeps only the lines that are the user's own messages.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:781  That is answerable only where the harness's format makes it certain (see
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:782  `export::USER_TURNS_HARNESSES`); elsewhere every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:783  session records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`. The flag is never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:784  silently ignored and content is never silently dropped.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:785
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:786  `--trim-to-window` drops lines whose own timestamp is outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:787  `--day`/`--since`/`--until`. A line whose timestamp cannot be read is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:788  kept and counted in `untimed_lines`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:789
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:790  `--out` must be empty or absent unless `--force` is given. Nothing is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:791  ever deleted, and nothing is ever written outside `--out`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:792
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:793  Exit codes, the same family `search` uses: `0` wrote at least one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:794  session and answered every session the query touched · `1` read the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:795  whole destination and selected nothing · `3` did not finish — part of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:796  the archive was unreadable, a session could not be placed, or a selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:797  session could not be written — so the output on disk is real but
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:798  incomplete, and the manifest says what is missing · `2` usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:800  Destination to export from. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:803  Directory to write into. Must be empty or absent unless `--force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:806  The shared filters (session / machine / harness / time window).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:809  Which lines to write: `all` (default), or `user` for only the user's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:810  own messages — kept only for harnesses whose format makes that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:811  certain; for any other harness every line is written and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:812  manifest records `turns_filter: "not-supported"`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:815  With a time window, also drop lines whose own timestamp lies outside
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:816  it. Lines whose time cannot be read are kept and counted in the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:817  manifest's `untimed_lines`. Requires a window.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:820  Write into a non-empty `--out`. Nothing is ever deleted, so files
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:821  from an earlier export stay where they are.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:824  Write every stored shard. By default a run that byte-for-byte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:825  replays the session's complete preceding shard sequence is collapsed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:826  to its first copy, because that is what a re-seal leaves. The archive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:827  is never modified either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:830  Print the plan and stop: no directory is created and no file is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:831  written.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:834  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:837  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:840  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:843  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:846  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:850  Open the archive dashboard in a browser: totals, the machine × source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:851  matrix, a weekly activity heatmap, and drill-down into any cell.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:852
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:853  Binds a short-lived HTTP server on `127.0.0.1` with an OS-assigned port
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:854  (never `0.0.0.0`, never a fixed port), prints the URL, optionally opens
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:855  your browser, and exits when idle or on Ctrl+C. Nothing is installed:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:856  no launchd, no systemd, no background process, no resident daemon.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:857
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:858  THREAT, stated plainly: loopback is NOT a security boundary. Every other
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:859  program running on this machine can connect to `127.0.0.1`, so this is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:860  not "safe because it's local". Access is gated by a random token that is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:861  generated fresh on every launch and appears only in the printed URL —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:862  never in a file, never in a log. Requests without that exact token are
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:863  refused (403), and any method other than GET is refused (405). Treat the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:864  URL as a secret for the lifetime of the process.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:865
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:866  Metadata tier: the dashboard and every list are rendered from one read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:867  snapshot + index + tree metadata plus the activity sidecar. The only
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:868  conversation text that read carries is each session's one-line label
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:869  (at most 100 characters, recorded in the activity index); a session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:870  full conversation is fetched and decrypted only when you click it and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:871  then click "load", and the byte cost is printed before you do. Exit
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:872  codes: 0 served the dashboard — even an archive that holds nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:873  which is served as an honest empty page rather than not starting; 3
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:874  could not finish reading (or no key), and is also the exit status after
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:875  serving an archive that could not be read in full; 2 is a usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:877  Deprecated alias for `ui`; prints a one-line notice on stderr and behaves
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:878  identically. Kept for one release.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:880  Backfill the audit sidecar from historical sealed bodies without rewriting them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:882  Stage receiving the derived sidecar; source bodies remain untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:885  Partition owned by this writer.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:888  Retained archive-wide random secret (exactly 32 bytes), outside stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:891  Scan only the stage, explicitly excluding historical destination bodies.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:901  Import an official export — or one harness's local-cache backup.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:902
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:903  Two modes share this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:904
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:905  **Takeout mode** (with a `<platform>` and `<export>`): archive the file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:906  byte-exact, and write one inbox bundle per conversation into a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:907  inbox. Reads `<export>` whole, stores it under
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:908  `<stage>/import-raw/<platform>/<sha256>` — a sibling of `sessions/`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:909  so it is in no session count — and writes one `chat-stasher/inbox@3`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:910  `web-capture` bundle per conversation into `--inbox`. A later
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:911  `ingest --inbox` is what seals them; this mode never seals, never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:912  pushes, never reads the config, a destination or a machine identity,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:913  and never modifies or moves the export file.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:914
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:915  Claude's `conversations.json` and Grok's `prod-grok-backend.json`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:916  have parsers in this build; naming any other platform is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:917  refusal, not a guess.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:918
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:919  **Backup-restore mode** (`--harness grok-bot --from <dir>`): feed a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:920  copied Grok Bot cache — one backup directory, several, overlapping
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:921  ones, whatever was copied aside — into the archive once, as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:922  first-class pass instead of a `[harness_roots]` workaround. Each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:923  session found in the backup is delivered through its own delivered-set
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:924  identity (machine + agent uuid), so only rows that session has never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:925  archived are sealed: a backup that overlaps the live cache or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:926  earlier import adds exactly its new rows, once. Re-running the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:927  import delivers nothing. The backup is only ever read; the live cache
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:928  is never touched, and the ordinary collect after an import still
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:929  delivers only what is genuinely new. Each sealed shard's `_chat_stasher`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:930  line records that it came from a backup import, the backup directory's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:931  basename and the import time. `--dry-run` reports the per-session
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:932  counts and writes nothing anywhere.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:933
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:934  Exit codes (both modes): `0` = everything was read to the end and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:935  imported (takeout mode: everything importable was written) ·
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:936  `3` = an input was never read to the end, so nothing about what it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:937  holds is proven · `2` = it was read and is not something this build
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:938  imports · `1` = it was read, and a conversation, session or write
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:939  failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:941  Which platform's export this is.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:944  The export file, e.g. the unzipped Claude `conversations.json` or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:945  Grok `prod-grok-backend.json`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:946  A manifest is refused: its download links are one-time-use credentials.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:957  Only `grok-bot` exists today.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:965  Report the per-session counts without writing anything.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:982  destination.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:989  Consume ext inbox bundles into sealed staging shards.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:990
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:991  Reads complete `deepseek-<sessionId>.json` exports from `--inbox`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:992  (skipping `.part` files), archives each as one record in a sealed

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:994  the source file to `<inbox>/consumed/`. Idempotent by content: the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:995  bytes are never archived twice. Prints paths/counts/sha256 only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:997  Inbox directory holding the ext exports.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1012  Read every scanner session returned by `status` into our own stage.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1014  Harness sources are opened read-only. File-backed JSONL sources use a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1015  durable byte offset plus committed-prefix SHA-256; opencode SQLite
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1016  sessions use a durable logical high-water cursor. The cursor state lives
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1017  under chat-stasher's own data directory, not under any harness directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1018
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1019  Exit codes: 0 = every recognised session was archivable and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1020  collected; 3 = PARTIAL — the pass ran, but at least one harness
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1021  recognised sessions this build cannot archive (the `not archivable`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1022  line), so what was written is real but incomplete; 1 = the pass failed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1023  (collect itself errored, or individual sources could not be read).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1025  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1028  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1036  Named destination from the config. Read state is kept per
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1037  destination, so a different destination is a different debt set.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1044  Masterkey file override for the destination above.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1048  Seal one file already inside our stage into the next sealed-shard slot.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1049  This command never renames a harness-owned path.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1050

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1053  `rename`, with an evidence `seal_source` line **and** a `source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1054  confirmed` platform cell may be renamed. Everything else (Codex = fd-holder,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1055  opencode = sqlite, any unconfirmed harness) is refused with the active
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1056  file untouched — renaming an fd-holder silently drops its post-rename
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1057  data.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1059  Registry harness id that owns the active file (e.g. `claude-code`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1062  Path of a file already inside --stage to seal. Paths outside the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1063  stage are rejected and left untouched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1066  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1069  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1070  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1071  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1074  Session id to seal into. Default: the active file's stem.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1077  Maximum sealed shards per bucket (default: 20).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1081  Reclaim the sealed shard body from the staging tree, but only where the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1082  archive provably holds every byte (ADR-020 Phase 4).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1083
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1084  The stage is an unbounded local full copy; nothing ever shrinks it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1085  This command retires the shard body once every declared destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1086  proves it holds each session. Proof means asking the archive itself —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1087  never the local cursor — for every session's digest triple (shard
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1088  count / concatenated bytes / concatenated sha256) and matching it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1089  against the stage. A destination that cannot be consulted is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1090  "unproven" and blocks the reclaim: it is never treated as "does not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1091  have it". Every declared destination must prove it holds each session,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1092  or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1093  nothing is deleted.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1094
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1095  Default is a dry run that reports what would be reclaimed and deletes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1096  nothing; pass `--apply` to actually remove the body. `--apply` writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1097  each machine's retained summaries first, then deletes session by
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1098  session, keeping each session's persistent `shard-seq` counter so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1099  next sequence never falls back onto archived shard names.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1101  Exit codes: 0 = reclaimable (dry run) or reclaimed (apply); 1 =
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1102  blocked — at least one destination is unreachable, partial, or fails
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1103  to hold a session, so nothing was deleted; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1105  Stage directory that holds the sealed `sessions/` tree.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1108  Actually delete the proven shard body. Default: dry run (report only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1111  Repository path override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1114  Masterkey file override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1117  Concurrency cap override (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1120  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable (single-destination config only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1123  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1127  Report the packs one destination's backend holds that **no index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1128  names** — what a push killed between its packs and its index strands —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1129  and say what the next push would do about each. Deletes nothing; there
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1130  is no mode in this build that deletes.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1131
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1132  Dry run is the only mode. `--apply` is refused with exit `3`, naming
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1133  what a safe delete would need and this build does not have: a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1134  repository-wide lock every client honors, a conditional delete carrying
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1135  an object version, and a trustworthy backend modification time to age
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1136  candidates by. "Unindexed" means no index file names the pack, not that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1137  the pack is unused — a retry can reuse one and write a snapshot that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1138  depends on it while it stays unindexed on disk — so the gap is real, not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1139  a formality.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1140
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1141  Every pack it reports is verified the way the adopting open verifies one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1142  before reusing it: the header must decrypt, every blob it declares must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1143  decrypt and hash to the id the header gives, and the pack's bytes must
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1144  hash to the id it is stored under. A pack that fails any of those is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1145  reported **unknown** with the verifier's reason, never as empty and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1146  never as zero, and its presence makes the whole survey incomplete.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1147
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1148  Reads only: nothing is written to the repository, to an index file or to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1149  a pack. The report carries the repository fingerprint, the backend
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1150  family, pack and byte totals, the unindexed packs by id prefix and size,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1151  what the next push would adopt, and any pack an index names that the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1152  backend does not list. It never carries a path, a host, a machine or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1153  account name, or any conversation text.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1154
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1155  Exit codes: 0 = the survey finished and read every pack; 1 = the survey
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1156  finished and found a contradiction (an index naming a pack the backend
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1157  does not have); 3 = it did not finish reading — a pack or an index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1158  could not be read, the backend was unreachable, or `--apply` was asked
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1159  for — so no absence in the output proves anything; 2 = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1161  Named destination from the config. Required unless `--repo` is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1164  Check the destination and stop: no repository is opened and nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1165  is deleted. This is what happens without the flag too.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1168  Refused. Present so that asking to delete gets an answer that names
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1169  what a safe delete would need, rather than an unknown-flag error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1172  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1173  Candidate packs carry their full id, for audit; the human report
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1174  prints a 12-character prefix.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1177  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1180  Masterkey file override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1183  Concurrency cap override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1186  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1189  Keep the ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run (do not shut them down).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1193  Register this executable as the browsers' Native Messaging host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1194  (ADR-014 step 2) — or, with `--uninstall`, remove that registration.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1195
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1196  ADR-014 exists because `chrome.downloads` with `saveAs: false` is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1197  overridden by the browser-level "ask where to save each file before
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1198  downloading" preference, which no extension flag can suppress. At up to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1199  200 backfilled conversations a day that is 200 modal dialogs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1200
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1201  This is one command instead of the five physical actions Native
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1202  Messaging otherwise costs: it renders the host manifest (`name` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1203  `description` / the absolute `path` of *this* executable / `type:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1204  stdio` / the pinned extension allowlist) and drops it into each
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1205  installed browser's discovery directory. No elevation: everything is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1206  per-user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1207
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1208  Every path written, left alone, skipped or removed is printed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1209  absolutely. "No error" is not the same claim as "a file landed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1210
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1211  Idempotent: run it twice and there is exactly one manifest per browser,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1212  byte-identical, exit 0 both times. Exit codes: 0 = at least one manifest
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1213  is in place (or, for `--uninstall`, removal finished), 3 = nothing was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1214  written because no known browser was found, 2 = usage error (bad host
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1215  name / extension id / relative binary path), 1 = an action failed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1217  Browser to register with, repeatable. Default: every browser whose
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1218  data directory exists on this machine. Naming one explicitly writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1219  it even when that directory is absent.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1222  Discovery root override (macOS default: `~/Library/Application
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1223  Support`). This is what makes the command testable without writing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1224  into a real browser directory.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1227  Which OS path layout to use. Default: this platform.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1230  Host binary recorded in the manifest. Default: this executable
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1231  (`std::env::current_exe()`), which is the only value that stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1232  correct after `cargo install --force`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1235  Host name override. Chromium's grammar is `[a-z0-9_.]` only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1238  Chrome/Chromium/Edge/Brave/Vivaldi extension id.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1241  Firefox add-on id (`browser_specific_settings.gecko.id`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1244  Remove the manifests this command writes — and nothing else.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1247  Windows only: skip the `reg.exe` step and only write the JSON.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1250  Stage the browser-spawned host is allowed to write to. Recorded in
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1251  the config as `[native_host] stage`. The directory must already
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1252  exist and be a directory: the host never creates a stage, and a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1253  stage that appears because a host was pointed at it is a stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1254  nothing pushes. The edit preserves the config file's comments and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1255  everything else in it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1259  The Native Messaging host process itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1260
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1261  Runs the same one-request-one-response loop the browser launch uses:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1262  reads one length-prefixed request frame from stdin, writes one response
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1263  frame to stdout, exits 0. Useful for driving the host by hand before any
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1264  browser is involved. Each process serves exactly one request — the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1265  browser starts one process per message, and the host is built for that.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1266
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1267  Nothing but that one frame may ever reach stdout: Chromium reads stdout
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1268  as a `u32` frame length, so a stray log line is read as a multi-gigabyte
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1269  frame and kills the pipe. Diagnostics go to stderr. A frame that ends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1270  early (EOF inside the length prefix or the body) is answered with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1271  silence and a non-zero exit, never with a response.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1272
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1273  `--self-test` prints one line of JSON on stdout and exits 0, unchanged:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1274  it answers "does the host process start at all?" without needing a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1275  request.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1277  Print one line of JSON describing this host, then exit 0.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1281  Build the activity sidecar index for one machine partition (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1282
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1283  Walks `<stage>/sessions/<machine>/<session>/<bucket>/NNNNNN.jsonl`,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1284  concatenates each session's shards in global sequence order, and feeds
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1285  every line through the conversation-time extractor to produce one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1286  `ActivityRow` per session. The rows are written as JSONL to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1287  `<stage>/meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl` — the file the `overview`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1288  command reads back out of a destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1289
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1290  With `--rebuild --destination`, the index is rebuilt from the archive,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1291  which is all a machine whose stage is gone still needs: no source
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1292  machine, and no copy of its stage.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1293
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1294  What that rebuild does depends on which partition is named and on
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1295  whether there is a stage to restore into, because a partition's index is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1296  written by the machine that owns it (ADR-017):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1297
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1298  * **This machine's own partition, with a `--stage` directory** — every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1299    archived session is restored to a temporary child of it, the full
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1300    index is rebuilt and a new complete snapshot is appended. Existing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1301    snapshots stay immutable; nothing is pushed until the scan and every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1302    restore finish. A same-machine snapshot found before publication
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1303    restarts the rebuild so the appended snapshot cannot hide it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1304  * **Any other machine, or any machine when there is no stage directory
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1305    to restore into** — the rebuild is **read-only**. That machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1306    archived sessions are read cumulatively across its snapshots and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1307    rows are written to a derived index in this machine's cache (the path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1308    is printed). The destination is not modified at all: no snapshot is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1309    appended and no path in the named machine's partition is written,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1310    because no record authorizes one machine to rewrite another's.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1311
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1312  Both modes are safe to re-run, and neither is resumable: each run starts
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1313  over. A read-only run needs the destination and the masterkey, and no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1314  `--stage` at all — which is how a machine whose stage is gone, this one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1315  included, still derives its index from the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1316
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1317  The harness label is inferred from the session directory name: the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1318  canonical archived ids are `<source>.<machine>.<native-id>`, so the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1319  harness is the leading dot-segment (`claude-code.<m>.<uuid>` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1320  `claude-code`); short forms are handled too (`opencode~abc123` ->
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1321  `opencode`, `cursor.d~xxx` -> `cursor`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1322
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1323  Metadata, with one declared exception: the extraction keeps a timestamp
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1324  per line and throws the line away, and — for claude-code sessions —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1325  additionally keeps the capped one-line label the dashboard lists the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1326  session under (the harness's own title, or the head of the session's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1327  first user line; see the `ui` labels). That label — at most 100
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1328  characters, with its provenance — is the one piece of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1329  conversation-derived text the metadata tier ever holds. Nothing else is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1330  ever kept, and the report is counts and the output path only.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1331
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1332  Exit codes: `0` = the whole partition was read and the index written;
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1333  `3` = the stage could not be read (or reading was interrupted) — nothing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1334  (complete) was written; `1` = every session was read but the index file
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1335  itself could not be written; `2` = usage error. Same family as
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1336  `collect`/`search`: `3` means "did not finish / never started", `1`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1337  means "finished and then failed".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1339  Local stage directory, or an existing workspace directory for a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1340  destination rebuild of **this** machine's own partition (temporary
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1341  restored shards are removed after the new snapshot is written).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1342  Omitted, or not a directory, the rebuild restores nothing and is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1343  read-only for any machine, this one included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1346  Machine partition for `sessions/<machine>/…`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1347  Default: config `machine`, else this machine's identity (generated
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1348  on first use); use `--machine` explicitly to choose the partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1351  Explicitly rebuild the complete partition index. The command has
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1352  always rebuilt rather than incrementally patched; this spelling is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1353  provided for repair workflows and makes that intent visible.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1356  Destination to rebuild from. Requires `--rebuild`; either this or
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1357  `--repo` must be named. Appends the repaired snapshot when the named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1358  `--machine` is this machine's own partition and `--stage` is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1359  directory; otherwise the rebuild is read-only and the result goes to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1360  a derived local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1363  Repository path override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1366  Masterkey file override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1369  Concurrency cap override for destination rebuilds.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1372  Backend option `key=value`, repeatable.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1375  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1379  Write this machine's display-name declaration (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1380
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1381  Writes `<stage>/meta/<machine>/machine.json` — a `MachineDeclaration`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1382  that carries the human display name, the OS and a first-seen time. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1383  machine partition is resolved exactly like every other command: config
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1384  `machine` first, then the identity file (generated when missing). The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1385  next `push` archives the whole stage root, so this file rides along.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1386
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1387  The display name is taken from `--display-name` when given; otherwise
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1388  the system's LocalHostName (`scutil --get LocalHostName` on macOS,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1389  `hostname` elsewhere) is used. If neither is available the field is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1390  written **empty** and the command says so — a name is never invented.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1391
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1392  Exit codes: `0` = the declaration was written; `3` = the machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1393  partition could not be resolved or the identity is unusable; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1394  file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1396  Stage directory to write the declaration into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1399  Human display name for this machine. Default: system LocalHostName.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1403  Give a dead or sold machine a display name (ADR-018).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1404
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1405  Writes `<stage>/meta/<target>/label-by-<local-identity>.json` — a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1406  `LabelRecord` expressing *this* machine's opinion about what `<target>`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1407  should be called. It exists for machines that can no longer declare for
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1408  themselves (sold, dead, in a different building). Each file has exactly
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1409  one writer, so concurrent machines never fight over it; the overview
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1410  shows the label with the latest `written_at_unix`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1411
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1412  Exit codes: `0` = the label was written; `3` = the local identity could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1413  not be resolved; `1` = the file could not be written; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1415  Stage directory to write the label into (`<stage>/meta/…`).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1418  Machine id (partition) being labelled, e.g. a 32-hex identity.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1421  Display-name override for the target.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1425  Draw the machine × harness activity overview of one destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1426  (ADR-017).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1427
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1428  Opens the destination repository, takes each host's newest snapshot
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1429  (the same cross-machine merge as `read --all-machines`), and for every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1430  snapshot recursively finds the activity index files at
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1431  `meta/<machine>/activity-v1.jsonl`. The paths carry each machine's own
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1432  absolute stage prefix, so they are matched by the trailing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1433  `meta` / `<machine>` / `activity-v1.jsonl` marker — never by a local
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1434  path. The indexes are parsed into overview rows and rendered as a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1435  machine × harness matrix, a time-unknown tally and a width-adaptive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1436  heatmap. Prints counts, machine names and time spans only — never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1437  conversation content.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1438
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1439  A machine that has a snapshot but **no** activity index is listed
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1440  explicitly as "index missing" — it never vanishes silently, because a missing
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1441  index is not the same thing as "that machine had no sessions".
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1442
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1443  Exit codes: `0` = at least one index was read and rendered; `1` = the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1444  whole repository was read and there is no activity index at all (a real
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1445  "there is none", not a failure to look); `3` = the repository could not
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1446  be read in full (open / snapshot / tree / dump failure) — the absences
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1447  below are unproven; `2` = usage error.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1449  Destination to open. Required unless an explicit `--repo` is given:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1450  there is no default destination.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1453  Terminal width for the matrix/heatmap (default: 100).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1456  Print exactly one JSON object to stdout and nothing else (the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1457  human matrix/heatmap is suppressed). Per-session `first_unix` /
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1458  `last_unix` and `time_source` are tri-state tagged
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1459  `{"kind":"known",…}` / `{"kind":"unknown","why":…}` — an unknown
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1460  time is never `null`. `no_index_anywhere` is `true` on exit 1
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1461  (read in full, no index anywhere); a failed read (exit 3) puts the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1462  reason in `error`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1465  With `--json`, emit the aggregate summary variant instead of the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1466  full document: totals, one record per machine and per source, and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1467  the last 30 local days' counts, with no per-session array. The
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1468  variant is named `"summary"` in the object.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1471  Repository path override.

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1487  Manage this machine's body cache (ADR-034).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1488
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1489  The body cache holds the conversation bodies a read would otherwise pull
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1490  from a destination again, as the destination's own ciphertext. It is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1491  disposable by design: nothing here is part of the archive, and deleting
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1492  all of it changes nothing except how long the next read takes. Without a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1493  subcommand it prints the location, the quota and the current occupancy,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1494  so a cache you never meant to have is visible before you clear it.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1496  What to do; omit to see the current occupancy.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1500  Build or inspect the per-destination local full-text index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1505  Backfill an opt-in source's older history through its own app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1506  (ADR-058 D1). Only Grok Bot exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1507
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1508  The Grok Bot local cache is a bounded window, and every position
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1509  that fell out of it is gone from disk for good — but the server
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1510  still holds the conversation, and whenever the app opens one, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1511  app itself fetches the conversation's whole user-visible span into
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1512  view. `backfill grok-bot` relaunches the app with a debugging
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1513  connection that listens only on this machine, opens one
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1514  conversation at a time exactly as a person clicking the sidebar
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1515  would, waits while the app loads it, and delivers the rows the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1516  archive does not already hold — marked as backfilled, through the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1517  same session identity a collect uses, so nothing is added twice and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1518  an ordinary collect after a backfill stays incremental.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1519
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1520  **The default is a dry run**: with no extra flags the same
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1521  read-only traversal runs — it too relaunches and drives the app —
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1522  and it only reports (per conversation: rows it would add, the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1523  loaded span versus the locally held span, and the positions that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1524  will stay missing). Rows are delivered only with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1525  `--i-accept-the-risk`, which is what the public doc names, and the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1526  risk statement is printed before every run, a dry run included.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1527
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1528  The run is user-started only: no schedule, daemon or config path
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1529  can reach it. The app is restored to a normal launch at the end of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1530  every run — including Ctrl-C, where what has been delivered stays
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1531  delivered. The interior positions the vendor's service never sends
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1532  the app stay missing and the session's gap record and `partial`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1533  fidelity stand: the archive never claims completeness.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1534
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1535  Exit codes: `0` every selected conversation loaded and was
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1536  reported (or delivered) · `1` the traversal finished with findings
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1537  — a conversation that never finished loading within its wait and
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1538  was skipped whole, a `--conversation` prefix that matched nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1539  a restore that could not be verified — or the app could not be
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1540  restored to a normal launch · `2` usage (including a `--stage`
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1541  that is not a directory) · `3` the run refused (macOS only, app
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1542  not installed, a signed-in app unconfirmable, the debug endpoint
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1543  unusable) or stopped before finishing — a user interrupt or an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1544  app-layout change; partial work is kept and reported.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1546  The harness whose app-driven backfill this runs.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1547  Only `grok-bot` exists today.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1550  Existing stage directory receiving the sealed shards. Never
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1551  created.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1554  Deliver the rows the run finds (a real run). Without this flag

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1581  Hide one archived session from ordinary readers (ADR-046 draft,

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1586  The state is a durable control record appended to this machine's
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1587  `meta/<machine>/deletion-control-v1.jsonl` in the stage; the next
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1588  ordinary `push` archives it with the stage, and every machine honors
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1589  it from the destination's control stream. The identity is exact: the

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1596  appended durably · `2` usage (`--stage` missing or not a directory,

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1652  Purge one named session from selected destinations — a dry-run
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1653  preview only (W402 interaction design). It reads every selected
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1654  destination and reports, per destination, whether the exact named
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1655  identity was **found** (with shard-file and byte counts across every
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1656  snapshot that holds it), **absent** (proved by a complete read of
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1657  every snapshot), or **unknown** (the destination could not be read to
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1658  completion — never spelled "absent"). It deletes nothing and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1659  nothing: no archive, stage, destination or index is changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1660
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1661  **The default is the dry run, and this build has no other mode.**
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1662  The destructive purge — the exclusive maintenance gate, the tombstone
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1663  publication barrier, snapshot rewrite, forget and prune (ADR-046
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1664  draft Phase 3) — is not implemented. `--confirm SESSION` exists so
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1665  that asking for the real deletion gets the phase boundary, not an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1666  unknown-flag error; it is refused and this build deletes nothing,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1667  ever.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1668
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1669  The identity is exact: the session id as named, in one machine
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1670  partition (`--machine`; default this machine's) — same-id sessions
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1671  in other partitions are not the target. Destinations are explicit:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1672  repeat `--destination`, or pass `--all-destinations`; there is no
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1673  implicit destination set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1674
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1675  Exit codes: `0` every selected destination was read to completion
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1676  (each reported `found`, a would-purge inventory, or `absent`) ·
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1677  `2` usage (no destinations selected, both selection modes at once, an
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1678  unknown destination name, a `--confirm` value that does not name
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1679  the exact session) · `3` `--confirm` was refused (the destructive
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1680  transaction does not exist in this build), or a destination could
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1681  not be read to completion — the target's status there is unknown,
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1682  and an absence proves nothing. `1` is not used by this command.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1684  Exact session id to purge. Never prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1686  Machine partition of the target identity. Default: this

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1694  Inspect every destination the config declares. Explicit: with
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1695  no `--destination` and no `--all-destinations` the command is a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1696  usage error, because there is no implicit destination set.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1699  Preview and stop. This is also what happens without the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1700  flag; the flag exists so a script can say what it expected.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1703  Real execution — refused in this build. The value must name the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1704  exact session being confirmed; anything else is a usage error
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1705  either way.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1708  Print exactly one JSON object on stdout and nothing else there.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1711  Repository path override (single-destination mode only).

help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1731  The command surface exists because the design names it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1732  (`docs-dev/redaction-and-recollection.md`, ADR-046 draft §5):
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1733  redaction is the destructive transaction of a later phase — record
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1734  the cutoff tombstone, remove the old scoped occurrences from stage
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1735  and every destination, then seal the replacement. Until that phase
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1736  ships, asking for it gets this refusal rather than an unknown-flag
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1737  error, and nothing is read or changed.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1738
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1739  Exit codes: `2` always — a deliberate refusal, not a failure to run:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1740  the operation does not exist in this build.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1742  Exact session id to redact. Never prefix-matched.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1744  Machine partition of the target identity. Default: this
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1745  machine's partition.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1751  `cache` subcommands.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1754  Delete every cached body block.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1755
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1756  Only the cache directory is touched — never the archive, never a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1757  destination, never a key. Entries are re-fetched from the destination
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1758  the next time a session is read.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1764  Destination to index. Required unless an explicit repository is given.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1767  Repository path override.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1770  Masterkey file override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1773  Concurrency cap override (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1776  Backend option key=value, repeatable (build only).
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1779  Keep ssh ControlMaster processes open after this run.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1786  Read changed sessions from the archive and update the local FTS index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1788  Validate and count indexed sessions without contacting the archive.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1790  Delete this destination's marked local index.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1896  The parameters of the remote step, exactly as the caller supplied them.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1897
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1898  Every field here is either a name or a location. **No field can carry a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1899  secret**, and that is the point of the shape rather than an accident of it:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1900  the two credential fields are the *names of environment variables*, which the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1901  wizard writes into the config as `env:NAME` and never resolves itself. So a
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1902  secret cannot reach the config file as plaintext, and it cannot reach
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1903  `argv` — where it would be captured by the process list and by any log that
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1904  echoes the command — because there is no flag that would accept one.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1907  Which recipe to write.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1910  SFTP: `ssh://<host>:<port>`. S3: the service endpoint, e.g.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1911  `https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1914  SFTP only: the ssh user.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1917  SFTP only: the private key to authenticate with. Optional — leaving it
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1918  out lets the backend use the ssh agent and its own default keys, which is
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1919  a real configuration rather than a gap.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1922  S3 only: the bucket (or container) the repository lives in.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1925  S3 only: the region. R2 is single-region and names it `auto`; another
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1926  S3-compatible service names its own.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1929  Both kinds: the prefix inside the account/bucket that the repository
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1930  lives under. Optional, and omitted rather than defaulted: a prefix the
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1931  user did not choose would put their archive somewhere they did not name.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1934  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the access key
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1935  id. Not the key id itself.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1938  S3 only: **the name of** the environment variable holding the secret
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1939  access key. Not the secret.
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1942  Declare that this host's key was checked out of band, which authorizes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1943  recording it in `~/.ssh/known_hosts`. A declaration, not a verification:
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1944  nothing here, and nothing anywhere else, can check that the comparison
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1945  happened. Without it the wizard stops at an unknown host and writes
help_doc     crates/chat-stasher/src/main.rs:1946  nothing (ADR-039, rejected option E).
